summary: Tested partner onboarding flow end-to-end for new five-tab onboarding + six-stage tracker. Backend API validations passed (7/7). UI verified login, tabs, dynamic service fields, Audit onboarding creation, stage 2/3/4 label updates, Stage 5 advance-payment guard, Stage 5 success, and Trial Balance upload persistence. Found a critical integration bug when opening tracker from Client Master pipeline action.

integration_issues.flow: Client Master -> Pipeline action -> Onboarding Tracker
integration_issues.issue: Tracker opens at /app/clients/{client_id}/onboarding (no onboarding_id), then OnboardingTracker consumes /api/onboarding/client/{client_id} array item that lacks stage_tracker/documents. Result: action text blank and required document rows disappear (doc_rows=0) even when pipeline is Stage 5 and should show PBC/Trial Balance slots.

action_items: Fix tracker hydration for /app/clients/{client_id}/onboarding route: either return stage_tracker + documents in GET /api/onboarding/client/{client_id}, or fetch GET /api/onboarding/{onboarding_id} before rendering tracker details.
For multi-service clients, route Pipeline action with explicit onboarding_id to keep one-service-one-pipeline linkage deterministic end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientMaster pipeline button navigates by client_id only (no onboarding_id), which is brittle for multi-service clients and can open non-deterministic onboarding context.

OnboardingTracker.load handles array responses by taking response.data[0]; this drops per-record derived fields unless backend pre-enriches each record, causing empty stage actions/doc lists on client-level route.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_I20_Onboard_* onboarding records via API and TEST_UI_I20_* onboarding via UI; uploaded ui_trial_balance_final.csv under Stage 5 Trial Balance slot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduce integration bug quickly by opening Client Master, searching TEST_UI_I20_91403967 LLC, clicking Pipeline; tracker header shows Stage 5 but action/doc rows are blank. Navigating to explicit /app/clients/client_4e8c208a0176/onboarding/<onboarding_id> restores correct Stage 5 docs and upload controls.
rca of the issue: Root cause is response-shape mismatch. /api/onboarding/{onboarding_id} enriches with stage_tracker + documents, but /api/onboarding/client/{client_id} returns raw onboarding docs only. OnboardingTracker (client-only route) expects enriched fields and renders empty action/doc sections. This surfaces prominently when launched from Client Master pipeline action which does not pass onboarding_id.
